name: Bael Modan
summary: At Bael Modan, dwarven crews blast into the red earth in search of Titan relics. Their fortified outpost has driven the Stonespire tauren from sacred ground and kindled a bitter fight.

sections.title: Unearthed Secrets and Bloodshed
sections.body: Bael Modan's walls enclose Bael'dun Keep, siege cannons, gyrocopter landing pads, and a deep excavation pit. Dwarven prospectors came to Kalimdor convinced an ancient Titan facility lay beneath the red earth. Their blasting broke into sacred Stonespire tauren ground. The expedition made no call to negotiate. Gunfire and explosives drove the tribe from its ancestral lands, leaving survivors scattered and vengeful.

sections.title: The Price of Unearthed Relics
sections.body: The diggers have uncovered more than old stonework. One find is the Tear of the Moons, an artifact that brings paranoia and madness to those nearby. Feegly the Exiled, a prospector banished from the camp, fell wholly under its sway. When the stone returned to his grasp, he became a trogg. Outside the gates, enraged tauren seek retribution, while deadly relics threaten the dwarves within.

faq.q: Why are dwarves digging in the Barrens?
faq.answer: Dwarven crews search Kalimdor for ancient Titan structures and relics beneath the earth. They believe buried Titan research facilities hold clues to the origins of their race.

faq.q: What happened to the tauren who used to live here?
faq.answer: The Stonespire tribe once held these hills as holy ground. When the dwarves arrived, they blasted open the dig site with explosives, killing some tauren and driving others away while destroying their village.

Gann Stonespire is one of the few Stonespire survivors. After peaceful efforts failed, he made camp by the road outside Bael Modan. He calls on Horde travelers to sabotage the dwarven flying machines and kill the officers who destroyed his people's home.

faq.q: What is the Tear of the Moons?
faq.answer: The Tear of the Moons is a mysterious artifact found by the excavators. It drives mortals who handle it mad, and the exiled dwarf Feegly is obsessed with reclaiming it.

angles.text: As a tauren, you see Bael Modan as an open wound over the Stonespire tribe's sacred grounds. Helping Gann Stonespire seek vengeance honors the tribe.
As a dwarf, you see the Explorers' League pressing on to uncover Titan history. Its commanders' harsh tactics have earned the local tribes' fierce hatred.
